description: List recurring class schedules (the templates that generate class occurrences) — days, times, teacher, location and date span. Mindbody: GET /class/classschedules.

end_date.description: Only schedules active on or before this day (default start_date) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

staff_ids.description: Only taught by these staff ids.

start_date.description: Only schedules active on or after this day (default today) — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

name: mindbody_list_class_schedules
title: List class schedules
